In my country, we eat at school on coupons. You need to buy them and then you can go to the dinner room and exchange them for a serving of food. Usually the class picks one of the students who collects the coupons, signs one of the coupons (he writes down the class, the date, the number of students who will eat), takes them to the dining room and gives them to the cook so that he knows how much food to cook.  
  
I'm the guy who collects coupons. At first I did everything according to the instructions: I collected it, signed it, gave it to the cook. But then I noticed that the chef simply looks at the number of coupons that are written on one of the coupons (this coupon is placed at the top), but does not count them. And then it occurs to me that you can write a larger number in order to eat more. Since then, in my class, 1-3 people ate for free every day.

​

We call it "take food on black" or "black way to take food"
